description: Is this paid API up, and what does it charge right now? Unpaid calls return HTTP 402 at $0.001 USDC. Same resource URL as the REST route.

method.description: HTTP method to probe. Omit or send empty to default to GET. Must be GET or POST.

url.description: Absolute https URL, max 2048 characters. Port must be omitted or 443. Userinfo is rejected. Private, loopback, and literal IP hosts are refused.
